dawn.note: 熱度＝五項估值和過去 4 年比的百分位平均；方向＝四項趨勢，連續 4 週才翻；只用當天以前的資料；只作讀值

levels.note: 價格、200／365 日均線、50 週均線（週收盤算法：最近 49 根週 K 收盤＋當天收盤）（統一收盤）與 Bitview 的短期持有者成本、真實市場均價、實現價、長期持有者成本、活躍投資人成本（rows 第 10 欄）；只作讀值

cycle_cmp.note: 各輪週期頂部（model.json cycle_tops）之後每天收盤 ÷ 頂部收盤；at＝今天這個天數時的位置；low＝頂部後最低；back_day＝最低之後第一次收回頂部價的天數；只作讀值

framework.name: Daybreak 出場框架 v3
framework.unit: 以「100% ＝ 本週期打算賣出的全部持倉」計，不涉及任何人的實際持倉
framework.unit_en: Measured as "100% = everything you plan to sell this cycle"; no one's actual holdings are involved

hedge.rule: 收盤連 5 日在 200 日均線之下 → 減 20%；連 5 日收回或 MVRV Z 7 日均 < 0.5 → 補回
hedge.rule_en: Close below the 200-day MA for 5 straight days → cut 20%; buy back after 5 straight closes above it, or when the MVRV Z 7-day average < 0.5

onchain.rule: MVRV ÷ 前一輪高點連 5 日 ≥ 0.75 → 賣一階
onchain.rule_en: MVRV ÷ prior-cycle peak ≥ 0.75 for 5 straight days → sell one step

onchain.rule: 連 5 日 ≥ 0.80 → 再賣一階
onchain.rule_en: ≥ 0.80 for 5 straight days → sell one more step

onchain.rule: 前兩條觸發過後，每次收盤創新高但 MVRV ≤ 一年最高的 0.9 倍 → 賣一階
onchain.rule_en: After both have fired: each new closing high with MVRV ≤ 0.9× its 1-year high → sell one step

framework.top3: MVRV Z／NUPL／Puell 四年百分位任兩項 ≥ 80 標為頂部區，只作讀值、不連動賣出。原本的加速規則（≥ 85 多賣兩階、≥ 90 全部賣完）在過去四輪都於週期中段先觸發，2026-11-05 取消
framework.top3_en: Any two of the MVRV Z / NUPL / Puell 4-year percentiles at ≥ 80 marks the top zone; a reading only, with no selling attached. The old acceleration rule (≥ 85 sell two extra steps, ≥ 90 sell everything) fired mid-cycle first in all four past cycles and was dropped on 2026-11-05
framework.time_stop: 2029/10–2030/03 剩餘部位每月等量賣完
framework.time_stop_en: 2029/10–2030/03: sell the remainder in equal monthly amounts

title.zh: 持有者行為：3 項同時異動

fig.zh: 短期持有者實現獲利 7 日急降、短期持有者獲利比例 7 日急降、短期持有者連 7 天賠錢賣（SOPR < 1）
fig.en: STH realized profit: sharp 7-day drop; STH supply in profit: sharp 7-day drop; STH-SOPR below 1 for 7 days in a row

means.zh: 同一類的好幾項同時異動：單一指標可能是雜訊，同類多項一起動比較值得注意；各項的意思看各自的說明。
means.en: Several signals of the same kind fired together: one indicator alone can be noise, several moving at once deserve more attention; see each one for its meaning.

rule.zh: 同一類有 3 項以上同時異動（這次 3 項）。
rule.en: Three or more signals of the same kind at once (3 this time).

means.zh: 收盤跌破 200 日均線：長期趨勢轉弱的訊號之一；出場框架裡 200 日均線也是避險線。
means.en: The close fell below the 200-day average: one sign the long-term trend is weakening; it is also the hedge line in the exit plan.

rule.zh: 和上一期（前一天的資料）比，這個狀態翻過來了。每天只比較前後兩期，所以只有翻轉當天會出現，之後幾天標「第 N 天」。
rule.en: Compared with the previous edition (the prior day's data), this state flipped. Only consecutive editions are compared, so it fires on the day of the flip and then counts days.

title.zh: 短期持有者實現獲利 7 日急降

caveat.zh: CheckOnChain 已平滑，單日大額轉帳也會被算成賣出
caveat.en: smoothed by CheckOnChain; a single large transfer can show up as selling

means.zh: 短期持有者實現的獲利很少：賺錢可賣的人不多，或大家不急著賣。
means.en: Short-term holders realized little profit: few have gains to sell, or nobody is in a hurry.

rule.zh: 和 7 天前比的變化，放進近一年每天的 7 日變化排名，落在跌得最多的 2%（第 0.0 百分位）。
rule.en: The change versus 7 days ago ranks in the 2% largest drops of the past year (percentile 0.0).

title.zh: 認賠放大：價格更低、認賠更多
title.en: Loss-taking grows: lower price, bigger loss

caveat.zh: 不是實體調整；樣本 2013 年起約 20 次

means.zh: 價格更低、認賠也更大：恐慌性賣出正在放大（投降）。歷來投降常出現在下跌的後段，但不一定是最後一次。
means.en: Lower price with bigger loss-taking: panic selling is growing (capitulation). It often comes late in a decline, but not necessarily for the last time.

rule.zh: 價格擺動低點比 75 天內前一個更低，當時的認賠峰值大 25% 以上。
rule.en: A swing low below the previous one within 75 days, with a loss peak 25%+ larger.

title.zh: 短期持有者獲利比例 7 日急降
title.en: STH supply in profit: sharp 7-day drop

means.zh: 大多數短期持有者都在虧錢、整體套牢，恐慌情緒高；歷來這類低檔常接近局部低點。
means.en: Most short-term holders are under water, trapped and fearful; such lows have often been near local bottoms.

rule.zh: 和 7 天前比的變化，放進近一年每天的 7 日變化排名，落在跌得最多的 2%（第 0.5 百分位）。
rule.en: The change versus 7 days ago ranks in the 2% largest drops of the past year (percentile 0.5).

title.zh: ETF 連 5 個交易日淨流出
title.en: ETF net outflows 5 trading days in a row

means.zh: ETF 連續淨流出：美國現貨需求轉弱，傳統資金在撤。
means.en: Consecutive ETF net outflows: US spot demand is fading as traditional money pulls back.

rule.zh: 同一方向連續 5 天（5 天以上才列）。
rule.en: 5 days in a row in the same direction (listed from 5 days).

title.zh: 佐證燈號「交易所供給」亮起

fig.zh: 條件：90 日變化為負；現值 -0.3

means.zh: 這盞佐證燈亮起：這項條件支持目前的市場階段。佐證燈只顯示，不參與階段判定。
means.en: This supporting light turned on: the condition now supports the current market stage. Supporting lights are shown only and do not decide the stage.

rule.zh: 和上一期（前一天的資料）比，這個狀態翻過來了。每天只比較前後兩期，所以只有翻轉當天會出現，之後幾天標「第 N 天」。
rule.en: Compared with the previous edition (the prior day's data), this state flipped. Only consecutive editions are compared, so it fires on the day of the flip and then counts days.

title.zh: Coinbase 溢價（7 日均） 7 日急升

means.zh: Coinbase 比 Binance 貴很多：美國買盤（包含機構）特別積極。
means.en: Coinbase trades well above Binance: US buyers, institutions included, are unusually keen.

rule.zh: 和 7 天前比的變化，放進近一年每天的 7 日變化排名，落在漲得最多的 2%（第 98.9 百分位）。
rule.en: The change versus 7 days ago ranks in the 2% largest rises of the past year (percentile 98.9).

title.zh: 短期持有者連 7 天賠錢賣（SOPR < 1）
title.en: STH-SOPR below 1 for 7 days in a row

means.zh: 短期持有者連續多天賠錢賣：認賠潮延續，短期持有者的耐心在耗盡；歷來長段認賠之後常接近局部低點，但會持續多久不一定。
means.en: Short-term holders have sold at a loss for many days running: the capitulation is dragging on; long stretches like this have often been near local lows, but how long they last varies.

rule.zh: 同一方向連續 7 天（5 天以上才列）。
rule.en: 7 days in a row in the same direction (listed from 5 days).

title.zh: 相對未實現獲利在近地板區
title.en: Relative unrealized profit in the near-floor zone

means.zh: 全體未實現獲利佔市值的比例掉到 35–37.5%：2012 年起只在熊市後段到復甦初期出現，這一區的日子一年後都比當天高；但 90 天後和任一天差不多，而且過去第一次掉進來之後，180 天內多半還再跌一段（最多跌過 47%）。
means.en: Total unrealized profit fell to 35–37.5% of market cap: since 2012 only seen from late bear markets to early recoveries, and every such day was higher a year later; but 90 days later it is no better than any day, and after past first entries price usually fell further within 180 days (by as much as 47%).

rule.zh: 相對未實現獲利（未實現獲利 ÷ 市值）在 35% 以上、37.5% 以下。
rule.en: Relative unrealized profit (unrealized profit ÷ market cap) above 35% and at or below 37.5%.
